utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Registrar, will you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, case number IT-01-47-T, the Prosecutor versus Enver Hadzihasanovic and Amir Kubura.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Mr. Registrar. The appearances for the Prosecution, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. WITHOPF
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Mr. President. Good afternoon, Your Honours. Good afternoon, Counsel. For the Prosecution, Tecla Benjamin, Ekkehard Withopf, and Ruth Carver, the case manager.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Mr. Withopf. The appearances for the Defence, please.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honours. On behalf of General Hadzihasanovic, Edina Residovic, lead counsel; and Alexis Demirdjian, legal assistant. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. And the other Defence team.

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honours. On behalf of Mr. Kubura, Rodney Dixon, Fahrudin Ibrisimovic, and Nermin Mulalic, legal assistant.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. The Chamber bids good afternoon to all those present after the weekend. They also greet the representatives of the Prosecution, the Defence counsels, the accused, as well as all the staff of this courtroom, and the interpreters in particular. We have a witness today who is planned to take two days. The Prosecution has supplied an amended plan for this week and the week that follows. Regarding next week, we have envisaged Thursday, the 8th of April a hearing devoted to the admission of documents. Should the witness planned for Tuesday and Wednesday finish earlier, in that case we can address the admission of documents earlier. In that case, we can do it Wednesday rather than Thursday. But all that will depend on the way in which we observe the planning and the requirements of the hearings. We will now go into private session. So, Mr. Registrar, let us go into private session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, we are in open session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I shall now give the floor to Mr. Withopf for the planning for tomorrow, as we are about to adjourn and we have finished with the witness. You have the floor, Mr. Withopf.

utterances.speaker: MR. WITHOPF
utterances.text: Mr. President, Your Honours, for the reasons as explained on Friday, tomorrow there will, unfortunately, be no witness available. There will be two witnesses, however, on Wednesday. One of them is likely to carry on on Thursday, and we will have another witness scheduled for Friday. I thought that tomorrow morning, however, can be used for this informal meeting involving representatives of the Prosecution, Defence counsel, the Chamber's legal officer, and the registrar in order to discuss the issue of tendering the documents later on.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I thought that the informal meeting would be held only between the parties, the registry, and the legal officer of the Chamber, without the Judges.

utterances.speaker: MR. WITHOPF
utterances.text: That's right.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Because the interpreters added us. The interpreters seem to believe that we should be present -- no, without the Judges.

utterances.speaker: MR. WITHOPF
utterances.text: That's exactly correct, Mr. President. It's meant to be without the Judges.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well. So there will be no hearing tomorrow. There will be this meeting, informally, and we will resume the proceedings on Wednesday at 9.00, because we're working in the mornings Wednesday, Thursday, Friday. And then next Monday it will be in the afternoon and then again Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday of the following week. Have you had time to go and see the models, Mr. Withopf? When I see this empty space in front of us, I thought that perhaps it could be occupied by the model.

utterances.speaker: MR. WITHOPF
utterances.text: Mr. President, Your Honours, I'm as curious as you obviously are to see the model, but you should ask the question to my learned friends from the Defence side. I'm basically always available to see the model, and I'm looking forward to seeing it. So my friends from the Defence side are far better in a position to answer this question than I.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Madam Residovic.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. President, since my learned friend is impatient, before this hearing I suggest that it be on Wednesday, as we will have a witness who can view this model. And after that, we will be having two international witnesses, who will also be able to use the model. And we'll be working all three days in this courtroom, so I think that that would be the most appropriate way to finally set up the model. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Microphone not activated]

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone, Your Honour. Microphone, Your Honour, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I was just asking whether there were any other questions. If not, the hearing is adjourned. And please be back here on Wednesday at 9.00 a.m.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 31st day of March, 2004, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 6.34 p.m.,
